title: Fail loudly when a built-in tool isn't supported by the provider
description: chatlas PR #370 adds a clear error when `tool_web_search()` or `tool_web_fetch()` is registered with a provider that doesn't support them (e.g., sending an empty tool definition caused confusing 400 errors or silent failures). ellmer should similarly detect and raise an informative error when built-in/server-side tools are used with unsupported providers.

title: Merge multiple tool results into a single result block per tool call
description: chatlas PR #363 fixes a bug where MCP servers returning multiple content chunks for one tool call produced multiple `tool_result` blocks for the same tool ID, causing a 400 error from Anthropic. ellmer issue #1060 touches related territory but the specific fix of collapsing multiple content chunks into a single result block per tool call ID may not be fully covered.

title: Better error message when structured output response is truncated
description: chatlas PR #344 replaces a cryptic `JSONDecodeError` with a clear `ValueError` explaining the response hit the output token limit when `chat_structured()` returns truncated JSON. ellmer already has `finish_reason` and truncation warnings via PR #1029, but should verify that structured output truncation surfaces a similarly actionable error message rather than a parse failure.

title: Add `content_document_file()` and `content_document_url()` for text/CSV/code files
description: chatlas PR #345 adds `content_document_file()` and `content_document_url()` so users can pass text, Markdown, CSV, or code files as first-class content (with media type metadata) rather than inlining file text manually. ellmer has no equivalent `content_document_*` helpers and this would be a useful feature addition.

title: Replay built-in tool content only to the provider that produced it
description: chatlas PR #336 prevents cross-provider conversation transfer from breaking when built-in tool content (web search, fetch) is present, by filtering provider-specific content during set_turns(). ellmer's contents_record()/contents_replay() (issues #895, #984) doesn't appear to handle this provider-specific content isolation.

title: Support MCP 2.0.0 breaking API changes
description: chatlas PR #335 migrates MCP tool registration to the mcp 2.0.0 API after a breaking major version release. ellmer should verify its MCP integration still works with the latest mcp package versions and update if needed.

title: Provider files API for uploading files once and referencing by ID
description: chatlas PR #334 adds a provider files API so large PDFs or images can be uploaded once and referenced by ID in subsequent turns rather than re-sending bytes every turn. ellmer issue #868 tracks adding the OpenAI files API and this would generalize it across providers.

title: Support Bedrock Converse models in chat_aws_bedrock()
description: chatlas PR #377 adds a native Bedrock Runtime Converse provider covering the broad set of Bedrock models that don't use the Mantle or Messages endpoints, with full support for tools, reasoning, structured output, and cache controls. ellmer's open PR #1064 only covers bedrock-mantle support; Converse API support for non-mantle models may still be incomplete or missing from ellmer.
